post.description:
Cancel a single line item on a pre-production order. If this is the last active line item, the whole order is cancelled too.

This endpoint is not idempotent: calling it again for an already-cancelled line item returns a 400, not a repeated 204.

Eligibility is checked against the order's own pre-production flow (`PENDING`, `ON_HOLD`, `PAYMENT_NOT_RECEIVED`, `HAS_ISSUES`, `SOURCE_CHECK_FAILED`), which is intentionally broader than the statuses accepted by `POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel.json`. An order in `PENDING`, `HAS_ISSUES`, or `SOURCE_CHECK_FAILED` can have a line item cancelled here even though the whole-order cancel endpoint would reject it.

show-out-of-stock.name: show-out-of-stock
show-out-of-stock.description:
Depending on the value, it shows all variants or only those not out of stock. Without passing this query param, the list will contain only those variants in stock.
0 - show only variants that are in stock.
1 - also show variants out of stock (all variants).
Only `0` and `1` are accepted; `true` and `false` are not.

secret.description: Optional secret used to sign webhook payloads. It is never returned in responses.

sku.description: An empty string counts as not provided, and the generated SKU is kept.

is_economy_shipping_enabled.description: Enables or disables Economy shipping for the product. An order can use Economy shipping (`shipping_method` 4) only if every product in it has this flag enabled. When omitted, the current value is kept. Setting it to `true` for a product where `is_economy_shipping_eligible` is `false` returns a validation error.

shipping_template_id.description: Shipping template ID in the sales channel

src.description: Filled in from the uploaded image. In list, create and update responses it can be an empty string or missing; the single product endpoint always returns it.

angle.description: Rotation in degrees. Requests must send an integer. Responses can contain a fractional angle when the product was last edited outside the Public API.

pattern.description: Requests must send all four values as numbers. In responses a value can be null when the product was last edited outside the Public API and the stored pattern lacks it.

print_on_side.description: Side printing for canvases: `regular` extends the print area to the sides, `mirror` mirrors it to the sides, `off` stops printing on the sides.

salesChannelPropertiesInput.description: Properties specific to the sales channel of the shop. Which keys apply depends on the sales channel: Amazon - `free_shipping`, `bullet_points`, `no_variation_parent`, `brand_name`; Etsy - `free_shipping`, `personalisation`; BigCommerce - `categories`, `free_shipping`; eBay - `free_shipping`; Shopify - `collections`, `free_shipping`; Squarespace - `store_page`; TikTok - `delivery_service_id`, `warehouse_id`, `free_shipping`, `personalisation`. Custom integrations have no sales channel properties, so the object is ignored for them. A key that isn't a known sales channel property returns `400`. On update, the object replaces the stored properties: keys that are left out go back to their defaults.

free_shipping.description: Amazon, Etsy, BigCommerce, eBay, Shopify and TikTok.

brand_name.description: Amazon only. An Amazon approved brand name set on the Printify store.

sku.description: An empty string counts as not provided, and the generated SKU is kept.

is_economy_shipping_enabled.description: Enables Economy shipping for the product. An order can use Economy shipping (`shipping_method` 4) only if every product in it has this flag enabled. Applies only to products where `is_economy_shipping_eligible` is `true`; for other products the value is ignored. Defaults to `false`.

shipping_template_id.description: Shipping template ID in the sales channel

shipping_method.description: Shipping method of the order: 1 standard, 2 priority, 3 Printify Express, 4 Economy. Defaults to 1. Economy (4) is available only when every product in the order is eligible for it and has `is_economy_shipping_enabled` set to `true`, and the order ships to the US (excluding US islands). Otherwise the request fails with 422.

personalisation.description: Attaches a personalization created via the Create a personalization configuration endpoint to an order line item.

personalisation_strategy.description: Pass this value exactly as returned by the Create a personalization configuration response — it is an opaque value and should not be constructed manually. The one value worth knowing about explicitly is `manual`, which indicates a mapping issue caused by a label inconsistency (the personalizable product was changed). The order will require manual adjustment from the merchant and won't be sent to production automatically.

personalisation_instructions.description: Pass this value exactly as returned by the Create a personalization configuration response. It is an opaque reference token for most strategies, or human-readable free text when personalisation_strategy is manual.

items.description: At most 12 items can have the type "image".

approval.description:
Optional buyer approval of this personalization.

- Send it only after the buyer approves this personalization.
- It applies to every order that uses this config.
- It is ignored if any buyer input could not be applied, and the merchant reviews the order.
- Automatic submission needs the merchant setting "Automatically submit personalized orders that were approved by the buyer".
- The order then follows the merchant's submission rule.

require_all_personalization_fields.description:
Optional. When `true`, the request must include an item for every field returned by the personalization options endpoint.

- If any field is missing, the request fails with `400` and lists the missing `field_id` values.
- Use it to make sure no personalization field falls back to the product's placeholder design.
- Defaults to `false`.

image_url.description: Required when the item type is "image".

personalization.description: At most 12 items can have the type "image".

format.description: Optional preview image format. "png" renders the previews with a transparent background. Omit it to keep the default format and the mockup's default background.

priority.description: Queues the task in a separate priority lane so it is processed independently of the shop's regular previews. Honoured only for accounts with an agreed priority allowance; ignored for everyone else.

secret.description: Optional new secret used to sign webhook payloads. Omit it or send null to keep the current secret, or send an empty string to remove it. It is never returned in responses.
